headlines.title: Wisconsin reports its first measles death in decades, the third in the U.S. this week
headlines.description: The infant’s death followed a measles-associated death reported Wednesday in Pennsylvania and another Monday in New York.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Insurance denied her cancer treatment. One email changed everything.
headlines.description: After her insurer denied a milder chemotherapy her oncologist prescribed, breast cancer patient Elizabeth Nicholas emailed the CEO — and got it approved 14 hours later. NBC News' Kate Snow reports.

headlines.title: CVS Health Plans to Split Into Two Separate Companies
headlines.description: CVS Health says it is splitting in two, putting its retail pharmacy in one unit and its insurance side, which oversees Aetna and Caremark, will be separate. The CEO says the idea is to help customer engagement, affordability and care coordination.

headlines.title: How Rising Rates and Policy Changes May Impact Your Insurance
headlines.description: It's that time of year again: open enrollment season. With rates rising and changes affecting many plans, you might want to take a closer look at your plan before you renew. NBC's chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips to ensure you pick the best plan for your needs.

headlines.title: Some Babies Born With Peanut Allergy Could Grow Out of it: Study
headlines.description: A promising new study reveals many babies diagnosed with peanut allergies may no longer be allergic. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share more on these findings and what parents of children with a peanut allergy should know.

headlines.title: This is what moms told us they actually want this holiday season
headlines.description: Looking for a gift mom will actually use? A mother of two shares the best gifts for moms in 2026, from cozy loungewear and LED masks to coffee and chocolate.

headlines.title: Home Depot’s Black Friday sale has already started: 18+ deals you can shop now
headlines.description: Home Depot’s Black Friday sale has already begun, with up to 65% off home appliances, power tools, storage items, furniture and more.

headlines.title: How to prevent your pipes from freezing this winter, according to plumbers
headlines.description: Frozen pipes can burst and cause costly water damage. Plumbers share how to keep your pipes from freezing and what to do if one bursts.

headlines.title: KitchenAid’s popular stand mixer is $150 off ahead of holiday baking and gifting
headlines.description: The KitchenAid Artisan Series 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer is 30% off on Amazon today, saving you than $150 ahead of holiday shopping.

headlines.title: NBC’s Chloe Melas Opens Up About Parenting With Chronic Illness in Exclusive Book Excerpt
headlines.description: Chloe Melas, NBC News entertainment correspondent, has been living with a type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) called ulcerative colitis (UC) for 15 years.
